name: Cameron Boozer
headline: Rookie Cameron Boozer is filling the stat sheet for an unbeaten Grizzlies team even while his shot is still coming around.
good: He is averaging 17.7 points, 10.5 rebounds and 5.7 assists in 31.0 minutes over 6 starts, and Memphis is 6-0.
He posted his first career triple-double against Portland with 18 points, 12 rebounds and 12 assists, and the team was +20 with him on the floor.
He is shooting 96.6 percent at the line and 36.8 percent from three, and he hit the go-ahead jumper with 20 seconds left against Golden State on a 25 point, 13 rebound night.
He scored 27 points on 8 of 14 shooting in the 136-105 win over Sacramento, and his season grade is an A- (83).
bad: His overall shooting is only 37.6 percent from the field (effective FG 45.9 percent), including a 2 of 15 opener against Utah and 6 of 21 at Sacramento.
He averages 3.0 turnovers a game, with 6 against Golden State and 7 against Sacramento on Saturday.
fans: The coverage I found is mostly positive, with AP calling Memphis perhaps the surprise of the NBA at 5-0 and pointing to Boozer and Ty Jerome as the leaders. He is also described as an early Rookie of the Year favorite. I did not find reliable subreddit threads, so I can't speak for fan sentiment beyond the headlines.
outlook: Memphis hosts New Orleans on Monday night (01:00 UTC tip) as a 5.5 point favorite, going for a 7th straight win. If his shot percentage climbs toward his free throw and three point marks, his numbers should keep rising, though the turnovers are worth watching.
